definitions: A part of something, such as a cloth or a piece of paper, that is folded over
A line or crease produced by folding
An enclosure for sheep or other livestock
A group of people with shared beliefs or interests, especially a religious group
A bend in a layer of rock
examples: The sharp fold in the paper
The sheep were safe in the fold
He returned to the family fold
Deep folds in the velvet curtains
